newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch insurer Achmea sees 1996 net up 21 percent.
newsitem.headline: Dutch insurer Achmea sees 1996 net up 21 percent.

text.p: Dutch unlisted insurer and banking group Achmea Holding NV said on Thursday its provisional 1996 figures showed net profit rose by 21 percent to about 570 million guilders.
Total provisional group income grew by about four percent to 13.3 billion guilders, including investment income from insurance activities which went up by 13 percent to approximately 2.1 billion.
Achmea said profits on life insurance rose again last year and non-life insurance results stabilised.
Profits on banking activities, including mortgages, went up well and there was a substantial volume of new mortgage business, Achmea said.
The balance sheet total increased by 18 percent to about 50 billion guilders at the end of 1996. Group equity also grew by 18 percent to total 5.3 billion guilders at the end of the year.
Achmea cooperates with a number of European insurers in the Eureko group. Other members of this combination are Britain's Friends Provident, Sweden's Wasa, Portugal's BCP and Danmark's Topdanmark.
